title: Governed Repository Inventory and Evaluation convergence

phases.objective: Make Repository Inventory regeneration a bounded transaction of the existing governed generated-artifact writer that converges dependent Repository Evaluation outputs only after Inventory is deterministic and current, while keeping ordinary verification and self-hosting bootstrap proof read-only until writer authority is trusted on main; keep Remote MCP write-scope recovery separately bounded to its two canonical outputs.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository inventory verification gate, repository evaluation verifier, CI, trusted dispatcher, and governed generated-artifact writer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository governed work branch has stale Repository Inventory or dependent Repository Evaluation outputs, or a separately classified Remote MCP write-scope generated-state drift, under already-trusted authority or while installing or changing that authority.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Before mutation authority is trusted, Inventory and Evaluation prove deterministic six-output convergence read-only without committing or pushing generated files. After authority is trusted, repository_inventory_refresh deterministically converges Inventory first and Evaluation second, commits only the six registered repository-state outputs, reads back the exact result SHA, and dispatches read-only exact-head verification for both families. Remote MCP write-scope recovery remains a separate two-output bounded regeneration and is never silently absorbed into the six-output writer.
steps: Checkout the exact candidate head with read-only repository permission.
Run the shared Repository Inventory verification gate from Repository Inventory and CI.
Generate the three Inventory outputs twice and require identical SHA-256 identities across both passes.
Run the canonical Inventory currentness check and self-test after generation.
If committed Inventory is current, report current and continue normally.

For stale Inventory, keep the read-only classifier bounded to the three Inventory outputs and require same-repository governed branch identity, main-base freshness, trusted generator/package bytes, deterministic generation, and no extra dirty paths.
Publish bootstrap_pending only as read-only evidence; do not commit, push, dispatch candidate write code, mutate a protected branch, or force-push.

When Repository Evaluation handles a pull request bootstrap, first require scripts/repository-inventory-verification-gate.mjs to be byte-unchanged from trusted main, then reuse that same gate rather than creating a second bootstrap classifier.

If the shared gate returns bootstrap_pending, reuse the generated Inventory worktree only inside the read-only Evaluation job and require scripts/repository-evaluation.mjs and scripts/test-repository-evaluation.mjs to be byte-unchanged from trusted main.

Generate the three Evaluation outputs twice with enforcement, compare SHA-256 identities, run evaluation:test and enforced currentness, and require the complete local dirty set to equal exactly the three Inventory plus three Evaluation outputs.

Publish mad4b.repository-state-bootstrap-proof.v1 with repository_mutation=false, protected_branch_mutation=false, force_push=false, and no secrets; skip the normal committed-currentness loop only for this proven bootstrap_pending path.

When tracked-file churn makes Remote MCP write-scope inventory stale, classify it as a separate bounded generated-artifact recovery: regenerate and deterministic-check only http-generic-api/remote-mcp-write-scope-inventory.generated.json and docs/remote-mcp-write-scope-inventory.md before claiming full readiness.

A coupled recovery PR may carry the two Remote MCP write-scope outputs, regenerated Inventory and Evaluation outputs, and this E2E contract when those generated families are all stale together; runtime source, dependencies, migrations, grants, provider calls, credentials, and protected refs remain outside that recovery.
Do not expand repository_inventory_refresh's mutation write-set because of a Remote MCP recovery; its repository-state transaction remains exactly six Inventory plus Evaluation outputs.
After source authority merges to main, create or validate a non-protected generated-output work branch from exact trusted main and invoke repository_inventory_refresh through the sole trusted writer.
Inside the trusted mutation transaction, converge Inventory first: two generation passes, SHA-256 equality, inventory:check, and inventory:test.
Only after Inventory is deterministic and current, converge Evaluation second: two enforced generation passes, SHA-256 equality, evaluation:test, and enforced evaluation currentness.

Bound the trusted mutation write-set to docs/repository-inventory.json, docs/repository-inventory-summary.json, docs/repository-inventory.md, docs/repository-evaluation.json, docs/repository-evaluation-summary.json, and docs/repository-evaluation.md.
Re-read the remote target immediately before push, push without force, and require post-push remote readback to equal the generated commit SHA.
After writer readback, dispatch Repository Inventory and Repository Evaluation as read-only verifiers pinned to the same result SHA.
Preserve verification-dispatch evidence contract v1 and legacy primary workflow/workflow_file fields while adding the verifiers array for dual verification.

For a failed push-triggered Inventory run on exact main, classify only the live main SHA, reject stale event heads, and route recovery into chore/repository-inventory-main-sync-<sha12> rather than mutating main.

For a workflow_dispatch convergence request, require create_from_main=true, source_main_sha equal to expected_head_sha, the governed branch namespace, and live main equality before creating the branch.
If the convergence branch already exists, require its remote head to equal the exact source main SHA; refuse branch reuse with a different head.
assertions: Repository Inventory and CI use one shared read-only verification gate for currentness and bootstrap decisions.
The shared Inventory gate performs two generation passes and compares SHA-256 identities before claiming deterministic_generation_verified.
Repository Inventory pull-request verification has contents read only and performs no git push.
The stale Inventory classifier remains bounded to exactly the three Repository Inventory outputs before delegation or bootstrap proof.
Repository Evaluation bootstrap refuses to use a candidate-modified Inventory verification gate.
Repository Evaluation bootstrap reuses the shared Inventory gate and proceeds only when its canonical outcome is bootstrap_pending with deterministic generation and no repository mutation.
Repository Evaluation bootstrap requires its Evaluation generator and Evaluation self-test bytes to be unchanged from trusted main.
Repository Evaluation bootstrap generates Evaluation twice, hash-compares both passes, runs evaluation:test and enforced currentness, and requires exactly six generated repository-state dirty files.
Repository Evaluation bootstrap publishes canonical read-only proof and grants no contents write permission, commit, push, protected-ref mutation, or force push.
A coupled Remote MCP write-scope refresh writes only http-generic-api/remote-mcp-write-scope-inventory.generated.json and docs/remote-mcp-write-scope-inventory.md.
Repository Evaluation outputs are regenerated from the current Inventory fingerprint and evaluation:check passes with no blocking gaps.
The trusted repository_inventory_refresh mutation transaction may write exactly the three Repository Inventory outputs plus the three Repository Evaluation outputs and no other path.
Trusted writer Evaluation generation starts only after Inventory currentness and contract verification succeed.
Trusted writer Evaluation is generated twice, hash-compared for determinism, self-tested, and checked with enforcement before commit.
Remote MCP write-scope recovery does not enlarge the repository_inventory_refresh six-output mutation allowlist.
Candidate-modified generated-artifact mutation authority is never executed before it is trusted on main.
The ordinary automatic dispatcher still refuses unsafe candidate-modified mutation authority and retains exact-head and protected-target fail-closed boundaries.
The dispatcher has actions write only where needed for trusted delegation and does not become a repository content writer.
The governed writer requires an exact expected_head_sha and typed confirmation, rejects main and Production mutation targets, and never force-pushes.
The post-merge convergence uses a non-protected work branch; main and Production remain outside direct generated-artifact mutation targets.
Generated-artifact verification routes repository_inventory_refresh to both Repository Inventory and Repository Evaluation on the same resulting exact head.

Repository Evaluation workflow_dispatch supports optional exact target_ref and expected_head_sha pinning, validates remote identity, checks out that SHA without persisted credentials, and revalidates local and remote identity before evaluation.
Repository Evaluation remains read-only and never receives contents write permission or performs git push.
Verification dispatch evidence remains mad4b.generated-artifact-refresh-verification-dispatch.v1 with backward-compatible workflow and workflow_file fields plus the verifiers extension.
Push-triggered and workflow_dispatch-triggered Inventory recovery preserve exact-head and fail-closed source identity contracts.
A governed work-branch push may publish bootstrap evidence only within the Inventory gate's same-repository, main-base, non-protected branch contract; protected-ref pushes remain blocked.

Work Map Integration may retain the broad .github/workflows/** trigger required by pipeline connectivity, but its currentness and repair path must remain inactive for unrelated repository-state changes.
Main convergence creates only a non-protected branch and never turns the dispatcher into a direct protected-ref writer.
The generated-artifact-refresh maintenance tool remains the sole registered mutating repository maintenance tool.
Production deployment, database mutation, direct protected-ref mutation, provider calls, credential payload reads, and secret publication are outside this feature.

phases.objective: Observe the first trusted post-merge Repository State generated-output follow-up on a non-protected work branch, including Inventory plus Evaluation convergence, dual exact-head verification, push-run recovery, branch collision refusal, and canonical evidence.
blockers: The six-output Repository State writer introduced by this source change is not yet trusted on main; operational remains blocked until its first post-merge non-protected canary completes with dual exact-head verification.

phases.objective: Exercise stale SHA, main drift, changed Inventory generator/package contract, changed Evaluation generator/test contract, changed authority surface, candidate-modified bootstrap gate, nondeterministic Inventory, nondeterministic Evaluation, Remote MCP write-scope drift, dirty-set escape, no-op, verifier dispatch failure, and post-push readback mismatch paths.

Use the first post-merge generated-output work branch as the bounded canary for repository_inventory_refresh and dual Repository State verification; keep any Remote MCP write-scope recovery separately bounded to its two outputs.
Keep main and Production outside direct generated-artifact mutation targets while allowing trusted merged authority to govern ordinary work branches.
